title: What counts as evidence: receipts, results, and what does not count
summary: For each run autobuild writes autobuild/results/<run>/result.json and, for Git submissions, autobuild/receipts/<id>.json with status PASS or ERROR, the source commit, the tree SHA-256 and the published path. Only a PASS receipt is integration evidence. A test passing in a chat, a hand publication, or a direct push to main is LOCAL_PASS at best and must be labelled that way.
invariants: Use the evidence words FIELD_PASS, LOCAL_PASS, FIXTURE_PASS, SOURCE_PRESENT, UNKNOWN, FAIL, BLOCKED; never upgrade one.
An ERROR receipt is final for that submission id; fix the package and submit again under a new id.
Quote the receipt path when claiming a package integrated.
